About

Capital and craft for founders.

01 Capital invests in and incubates companies where fintech, blockchain and AI meet. We pair capital with hands-on support, because the hardest problems in these markets are rarely solved by money alone.

Our approach

Two arms, one team.

01

Invest

Our investment arm backs companies building the rails, infrastructure and intelligence of a new financial system.

02

Incubate

Our incubation arm works alongside founders and established businesses, from strategy and token design to technology, brand and go-to-market.

Our strengths

What we bring.

01

Industry experience

A team of blockchain veterans with more than a decade in the industry.

02

Technical and operations depth

A skilled technical and operations team with strong execution.

03

Global network

Relationships across the global Web3 ecosystem, from builders to service providers.

04

Track record

Many projects incubated and supported, from first product to launch.
